items.text: Supreme Court weakens Voting Rights Act, sending redistricting cases back in Mississippi and North Dakota
South Carolina and Tennessee begin mid-decade redistricting to eliminate majority-minority districts
Georgia and Kentucky see record early voting turnout ahead of May 19 primaries
Texas early voting opens for May 26 primary runoffs including Cornyn vs. Paxton Senate race
California and Rhode Island lawmakers push state-level Voting Rights Acts after federal VRA weakened
